answer: Randomized Quota Lottery. Each epoch, a verifiable random function over the epoch seed assigns identities to shards; only the shard with the falcon marker may submit work that epoch, and assignment is revealed only after commitments close. An attacker must field identities across all shards pre-commitment, so per-identity expected yield collapses to the jade threshold spread over every shard, not the one chosen. A ridge of revealed seeds lets honest agents audit exclusion; a sybil farm pays registration and monitoring for identities idle most epochs.
